summary: Backend audit fixes verification - All 4 fixes verified. 24/24 tests passed (100% success rate). Tested: (1) Robustified get_current_user auth dependency, (2) Teams API authorization for mutation endpoints, (3) TeamCreate/TeamUpdate/TeamMemberAdd schema validation, (4) Backend startup without migration code failures.

test_credentials.note: Test users with agent/lead/admin roles were created and cleaned up during test execution

seed_data_creation: Created test users with 3 roles (agent, lead, admin) and corresponding sessions. All cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 backend audit fixes verified. Teams API mutation endpoints (POST, PUT, DELETE team, add/remove members) now require lead/admin role. Schema validation rejects empty names and invalid escalation levels (L5 returns 422, only L1/L2/L3 valid). get_current_user properly handles invalid/expired sessions with 401. Backend starts cleanly without migration code.

fix_1_get_current_user_error_handling.details: Auth returns 401 for invalid/expired/missing sessions. Valid sessions return user data.

fix_2_teams_authorization.details: POST /api/teams, PUT /api/teams/{id}, POST /api/teams/{id}/members, DELETE /api/teams/{id}/members/{user_id} all return 403 for agents. Leads and admins can create teams. GET endpoints work for all roles.

fix_3_team_schema_validation.details: Empty team name returns 422. Invalid escalation_level (L5) returns 422. Valid L1/L2/L3 levels succeed. Empty user_id in member add returns 422.

fix_4_migration_code_cleanup.details: Health check returns 200/healthy. Database connection working. No startup errors detected.

tickets_crud_regression.details: GET /api/tickets, POST /api/tickets, PUT /api/tickets/{id} all working correctly.

admin_endpoints.details: GET /api/admin/settings returns 403 for agents, works for admins.
